prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 部分A股个股行情一览 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 7 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "代码" · longest unbreakable word 59px · one-line width 59px
  col 2: header "名称" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 62px
  col 3: header "最新价" · longest unbreakable word 60px · one-line width 60px
  col 4: header "涨跌幅" · longest unbreakable word 54px · one-line width 54px
  col 5: header "成交额（亿）" · longest unbreakable word 46px · one-line width 92px
  col 6: header "市盈率" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 46px
  col 7: header "所属行业" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 62px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
This table cannot fit without splitting words at 360px. You MAY choose a total wider than 359px (the reader then scrolls horizontally), or squeeze and accept splits — a design decision.
Rendering convention: the screenshot always shows the WHOLE table. Anything beyond the dashed box is not clipped; it is the part a reader reaches by scrolling sideways, so judge both what fits in the box at first sight and the cost of scrolling to the rest.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示部分A股个股的行情，帮助读者识别股票并比较价格、涨跌、成交额和估值。","reading":"读者先通过代码和名称定位个股，再沿行查看行情，也会纵向比较同一指标；手机首屏应优先呈现身份和主要行情。","groups":["代码、名称和所属行业共同描述股票身份及分类。","最新价与涨跌幅共同描述当前价格表现。","成交额与市盈率分别反映交易规模和估值，都是供纵向比较的数值指标。"],"keep_intact":["股票代码应尽量完整，避免识别错误。","价格、涨跌幅、成交额和市盈率的数字及符号应尽量保持完整，便于比较。"],"may_wrap":["名称和所属行业可按汉字自然换行，但应尽量保持词语易读。","较长的列标题可换行；若同一行已有单元格换行，其他文字换行可利用已有行高。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r1A: widths [80, 53, 81, 75, 67, 67, 53] · table 477×418px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 2/7 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 117px
Design r1B: widths [80, 83, 81, 75, 67, 67, 53] · table 507×325px · row heights [60, 36, 36, 36, 36, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 2/7 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 147px
Design r1C: widths [80, 53, 81, 75, 67, 56, 53] · table 466×418px · row heights [60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 60] · column headers wrapped 3/7 · tallest cell 2 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 106px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r1A","good":"代码、价格、涨跌幅和数值保持完整；前四列连同行情方向都能在首屏看到，便于先识别股票再比较表现。成交额标题换行为两行，仍可辨认。","problems":"所有数据行都偏高，名称被拆成短行，股票识别和横向扫读较费力；市盈率和行业需要横向滚动。","cause":"名称列和行业列均为53px，扣除内边距后仅有32px文字空间，较长名称及行业被迫换行。总宽477px，比视口宽117px。"},{"design":"r1B","good":"83px名称列让股票名称保持单行，前几行明显更紧凑，代码与名称的识别关系清楚；主要价格指标仍在首屏内。","problems":"后两行仍较高，行高节奏不一致；成交额在首屏右边缘附近，完整查看后续指标需要更多横向滚动。","cause":"行业列仍为53px，较长行业名称换行并撑高对应行；名称列比r1A宽30px，使总宽增至507px。"},{"design":"r1C","good":"保留了代码和主要行情数值的完整性；比r1A略窄，横向滚动距离有所减少。","problems":"名称导致的高行与碎片化阅读仍然存在；市盈率标题额外换行，表头层级更零碎，而节省的宽度不足以改变首屏可见的主要内容。","cause":"名称与行业列仍为53px；市盈率列从67px缩至56px，扣除内边距后只有35px，容不下46px的单行标题。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[80,83,81,75,67,67,83],"change":"保留r1B完整的单行股票名称，将行业列加宽至83px，尝试让行业名称也保持单行，使各数据行更均匀；代价是需要更多横向滚动。"},{"name":"compact-names","widths":[80,68,81,75,67,67,83],"change":"名称列设为68px，容纳约三个汉字；较长名称可自然换行，较短名称保持单行。行业列加宽，减少它对行高的影响，同时比完整名称方案节省15px横向宽度。"},{"name":"compact-scroll","widths":[80,83,81,75,67,56,68],"change":"保持股票名称和主要数值完整，将市盈率标题换行，并让行业列容纳约三个汉字，以降低横向滚动成本；用于检验标题及部分行业换行是否比增加表宽更合适。"}]}
